The hip now rises 1.73 m (31 px at 17.92 px/m) against the drawing's 1.8 m (32 px). K01 lets a pitch a source reads stand below its 25-degree ordinary floor, as it already let one stand above it (T-2542, T-3280)

differences.what: where the roof's apex and the stack's top draw: y 345 and 323 px in the render on this camera, against the drawing's 368 and 342
differences.how: a gap two camera fits disagree about (README § The match record): it is recession, not height. This camera recedes depth at T-1877's walk-and-stoop rates (0.30 m left, 0.22 m up a metre), and the apex is 5.3 m back, so it draws 21 px over its rise. Refitted to how the strip draws this house's own depth (the rates x 0.25, eye [312.24, -17.175, 21.3], principal point [1643.4, 210.3], rendered by T-1872 and not committed), the apex draws at y 366 against 368 and the south face all but hides behind the corner as drawn, but the stoop then draws face-on where the strip runs it down and right, and the stack's top at y 349 against 342, about 2 m north of the drawn stack at x 1960-1969 against 1927-1945. The strip draws its stoops and walks with recession and this roof with almost none; no one camera holds both, and on each the roof's own rise is the drawing's
